title: Software Quality Control & Process Improvement Lead
description: Nile Systems Research Institute (NSRI) is seeking a Software Quality Control & Process Improvement Lead for a 4-month systems audit project. You will lead an agile software engineering team in conducting software process audits, identifying efficiency bottlenecks, and implementing automated testing tools. The role requires designing regression testing strategies, executing fault-based testing, and ensuring strict compliance with software quality metrics. Strong experience in software team leadership and development in C, C++, or Java is required.
requirements: Proven experience as a Software Team Leader or Systems Engineer, supervising developer groups and managing release quality.
Expertise in software quality control, software process improvement methodologies, and test automation design.
Strong programming skills in C, C++, and Java, with a solid grasp of software architecture.
Experience implementing fault-based testing or regression test selection algorithms to minimize test effort.
Master's or PhD in Computer Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related field.
benefits: Opportunity to collaborate with government ministries and tech leaders
